drafted_from: tool:google-account-update_draft's own row in tools/read-and-write-gmail/tool-rows.json (invoke method, url, body_template, input and output schema); Gmail response values worked out from that row for the synthetic input
start_here: Say to your AI: "Change my draft r-7301442210 to say the order is ready at 4 PM. Use my Google account connection service_connection:google-account:sam-bakery." It runs tool:google-account-update_draft as that account and hands back the Gmail answer.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it calls Gmail for one Google account the connection names and answers what Gmail returns.
instructions: 1. Connect a Google account in your Workshop connections and note its handle, like service_connection:google-account:sam-bakery.

2. Say to your AI: "Change my draft r-7301442210 to say the order is ready at 4 PM." and let it call run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:google-account-update_draft, and the input {"connection":{"connection_id":"service_connection:google-account:sam-bakery"},"draft_id":"r-7301442210","raw":"RnJvbTogc2FtQGV4YW1wbGUuY29tDQpUbzogYWxleEBleGFtcGxlLmNvbQ0KU3ViamVjdDogT3JkZXIgcGlja3VwDQoNCllvdXIgYmFrZXJ5IG9yZGVyIGlzIHJlYWR5IGF0IDQgUE0u"}.

3. Read what comes back: the request goes as PUT  the Gmail me-mailbox base (gmail.googleapis.com, v1)/drafts/r-7301442210 with the body {"message":{"raw":"<that raw>"}} (threadId is left out because thread_id is not given).
4. The whole message is replaced, so raw must hold every header and the full body again.

worked_examples.title: Replace the contents of a Gmail draft on a sample input
worked_examples.ask: Change my draft r-7301442210 to say the order is ready at 4 PM.
worked_examples.given: read from tools/read-and-write-gmail/tool-rows.json (its invoke url, method and body_template) and checked against tools/read-and-write-gmail/test/rows.test.mjs. The draft r-7301442210 now saying 3 PM; raw is the base64url of the same message saying 4 PM. The call it makes: PUT the Gmail me-mailbox base (gmail.googleapis.com, v1)/drafts/r-7301442210 with the body {"message":{"raw":"<that raw>"}} (threadId is left out because thread_id is not given).
